stories.headline: Iran Strikes Kuwait With 7 Ballistic Missiles — Regional War Widens, Diplomatic Track Contradicted by Kinetic Activity
stories.thesis: Iran struck Kuwait, a major OPEC producer and US ally, with 7 ballistic missiles. Hormuz fully blockaded. Iran denies nuclear talks. Ceasefire hopes contradicted by active escalation.

stories.headline: China Launches Maritime Enforcement East of Taiwan — First Time Beijing Names Time, Place, Legal Basis
stories.thesis: Beijing announced a specific maritime traffic enforcement operation east of Taiwan with time, place, and legal basis for the first time. Markets dismiss as posturing. No vessel boarded yet.

stories.headline: Ukraine Hits St. Petersburg With 250+ Drones During PMEF — Military Base, Physics Institute Destroyed
stories.thesis: Ukraine struck Russia's second city during its flagship economic forum. Putin rejects peace talks. Russian budget deficit at 6.01T rubles, oil/gas revenues down 29.8%.

stories.headline: Bitcoin Free Fall — Saylor Liquidates, ETFs Bleed, 200-Week MA Tested at $61K
stories.thesis: BTC drops 5.5% as Strategy sells $2.5M — 'never sell' narrative dead. $11.5B unrealized loss. ETF outflows at record. 200-week MA is last line before cascade.

stories.headline: Google Signs $920M/Month AI Compute Deal With SpaceX — IPO 2x Oversubscribed at $75B
stories.thesis: Google locked in $920M/month AI compute with SpaceX. SpaceX loses $0.91 per dollar of revenue ($4.28B loss on $4.69B Q1 revenue). $1.8T+ valuation vs. real revenue. IPO June 12.

stories.headline: Zcash Soundness Researcher Now Audits Monero — XMR Recovers From -10% Panic to +4.77%
stories.thesis: The researcher who found Zcash's bug targets Monero. Core contradiction: privacy coins can't prove absence of bugs. Zcash was 'battle-tested' before its bug. XMR has no transparent fallback.
